nodes.name: Agent workbench
nodes.responsibility: Everything archboard owns around one private Codex child, inside the Archboard server

nodes.name: Codex transport
nodes.responsibility: One newline-framed JSON object at a time each way, correlated to its request, and each tool call routed to the owner registered for its namespace

nodes.name: Codex session
nodes.responsibility: One initialized session and the reviewed methods it will send

nodes.name: Workhorse queue
nodes.responsibility: Codex's queue of messages waiting for the workhorse: list, add, edit, reorder, delete, or start one now

nodes.name: Voice coordinator
nodes.responsibility: The separate fast thread voice attaches to, the voice model's subconscious, which routes sustained work to the workhorse

nodes.name: Workhorse operations
nodes.responsibility: The four things the coordinator may ask of a workhorse, one at a time: delegate, steer, inspect, manage its queue

nodes.name: Realtime voice
nodes.responsibility: Starts the realtime leg on the coordinator's thread, hands a narrated walkthrough's steps to the voice model, and carries its transcript back

nodes.name: Coordinator callbacks
nodes.responsibility: While voice is live, workhorse news for the coordinator and pane news for the voice model, each once and in order

queue a delegation behind the running turn
news as a coordinator turn/start; pane news appended
